quest.title: Tracking the Thunder
quest.description: Previous findings have caused Muzhen's research to make progress, but research is an ongoing process...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x50, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: I had a look at the crystals you brought back earlier. They seem rather... "young."

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: By that, I mean that they come from rather recent elemental crystallizations... To strike a comparison, this is but a slightly deeper footprint recently left in the snow.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: So this time, I'd like you to look for footprints that are more "shallow"... and follow them to their source!

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: When I say "shallow footprints," I mean deposits of Electro elements that have condensed to a certain extent near the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: If we are able to obtain sufficient samples of that for comparison, we should be able to draw a general route map.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shallow and deep footprints... route maps... Paimon's got no idea what you're on about.

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Well, maybe my analogy wasn't the best, but I think you'll figure it out just fine once you're there!

dialogues.speaker: Muzhen
dialogues.text: Well, guess that's all for the chit-chat. Time to get moving!

talks.objective: Go to the Electro anomaly and complete the challenge
